edges.why: every pane child registers in AiPair.Registry through PaneSupervisor.via_pane/1
edges.breaks: a pane quarantined by reconciliation could not register and whereis_pane would not find it

edges.why: reconciliation starts each quarantined child through a real {:start_child, spec} request to AiPair.PaneSupervisor
edges.breaks: every admissible pane would be refused quarantine_unavailable while the report claimed every source answered

edges.why: tmux_server defaults to AiPair.Tmux, so the boot census and every marker read go through that child
edges.breaks: census source_unavailable, marker_observation unobserved, every pane refused: a boot that restores nothing and looks healthy

edges.why: every mutating pane effect, reconciliation's included, runs inside one per-pane Coordinator fence
edges.breaks: transaction/2 answers coordinator_unavailable and reconciliation refuses every pane fence_refused

edges.why: the same fence, taken by the reconciliation worker for each admitted pane
edges.breaks: nothing is restored and every pane row carries fence_refused coordinator_unavailable

edges.why: Boot's first act is the reconciliation snapshot :list against the store's global name
edges.breaks: the call exits :noproc and is reported source_unavailable intent: the daemon comes up having reconciled nothing while every record sits on disk

edges.why: Boot.start_link/1 is ready on return, so the listen socket is not created until the one reconciliation attempt has settled and the report has been handed to the writer
edges.breaks: a client could attach while reconciliation runs; the pane fence prevents corruption but the outcome becomes timing dependent, and the rule is that no client may reach the daemon before the boot's one reconciliation attempt has settled

edges.why: IPC.Server.start_link/1 answers {:error, :receipt_store_unavailable} unless the receipt store is available
edges.breaks: boot fails closed with a misleading cause
